cases.title: XHS Benchmark Anchor: Antique Tabletop Cast-Iron Proof Press & 4-Tier Ink Tin Stack
cases.stability_reason: The assembled, section, and exploded sheets show clean coherent geometry without visible degenerate slivers, floating shards, or problematic clipping.
cases.aesthetics_reason: Proportions and part colors are coherent and mechanically plausible, with good small hardware detailing; the monochrome tins and simplified cast-frame surfaces are less visually rich than the heritage reference.
cases.task_prompt:
For industrial heritage digitization and mechanical CAD benchmarking (adapted from the 3DCodeFactory `paper_press` reference image `reference-0.jpg`), build a modular parametric CadQuery assembly under `output/src/` (`params.py`, `parts/*.py`, and `assembly.py` exposing `DEFAULT_PARAMS` and `build(params=None) -> cadquery.Assembly` in millimeters, Z-up).

Construct at least 7 distinct, named, separately colored, watertight, non-interfering (`0.0 mm^3` pairwise overlap) top-level parts at 1:4 engineering scale (`board_length_mm=295.0`, overall ~295 x 150 x 135 mm, >= 70 B-rep faces, primary side-frame profile drafted on the XZ plane): (1) `workbench_baseboard`: 295 x 150 x 11 mm board with perimeter edge banding supporting the press on the left-center two-thirds and the ink tins on the right; (2) `cast_iron_side_frames`: twin arched side frames (~82 x 8 x 100 mm) featuring circular lightening holes, bottom arch cutouts, bolted front guard cross-plate with hex bolt heads, and an inset brass plaque boss; (3) `impression_roller_and_bed`: central Ø26 mm cylindrical roller above the flat bed plate plus the open stepped booklet resting between the press and tins; (4) `spur_gear_train_and_crank`: exposed meshing spur gear pair with real gear teeth, bushing collars, and right-side crank handle; (5) `operating_levers_and_pull_handle`: long left-side operating lever and curved front-bottom pull handle; (6) `top_crossbeam_and_t_screws`: perforated top crossbeam carrying dual vertical pressure screws with washers and primary/secondary T-bar handles with end knobs; (7) `tiered_ink_tins`: 10 cylindrical lidded tins stacked in a 4-tier (4/3/2/1) stepped pyramid on the right side of the board.

Expose `board_length_mm=295.0` in `DEFAULT_PARAMS` and support `--probe board_length_mm=335`, extending the baseboard to 335 mm and shifting the 4-tier ink tin stack cleanly along +X while keeping all parts watertight with `0.0 mm^3` pairwise interference.

rubrics.criterion: Baseboard Left-Center Press & Right 4-Tier 10-Tin Stepped Layout
rubrics.reason: The banded baseboard supports the press on the left-center and ten lidded cylindrical tins on the right in a clear 4/3/2/1 stepped pyramid, with the booklet between them.

anchors.0: Press body or 4-tier ink tin pyramid missing or misplaced;
anchors.0.5: Press and tins present, but tin stack is not a 4/3/2/1 4-tier stepped pyramid or proportions strongly deviate from reference I;
anchors.1: Press sits on the left-center two-thirds of the banded baseboard alongside 10 lidded cylindrical tins in a crisp 4-tier stepped pyramid matching I.

rubrics.criterion: Twin Arched Cutout Side Frames, Bolted Front Guard & Nameplate Boss
rubrics.reason: Both arched side frames have circular lightening holes and large bottom arch cutouts; the front guard shows multiple hex bolt heads and a small inset brass plaque boss.

anchors.0: Side frames reduced to plain solid slabs without cutouts;
anchors.0.5: Arched frames present, but missing circular lightening holes, bottom cutouts, or bolted front guard plate;
anchors.1: Twin arched frames clearly show circular lightening holes, bottom cutouts, hex-bolted front guard beam, and inset brass plaque boss.

rubrics.criterion: Exposed Toothed Spur Gear Pair & Three Distinct Handles/Levers
rubrics.reason: The exposed meshing gears have modeled teeth and bushing collars, accompanied by a right crank, long left operating lever, and curved front-bottom pull handle.

anchors.0: Gear train and operating levers omitted;
anchors.0.5: Smooth disks used instead of toothed gears, or missing left long lever / front curved pull handle;
anchors.1: Meshing toothed spur gear pair, bushings, right crank, left long lever, and front-bottom curved pull handle are all clearly modeled.

rubrics.criterion: Perforated Top Crossbeam & Dual T-Bar Pressure Screws
rubrics.reason: A perforated top crossbeam carries two vertical pressure screws with washers and separate primary and secondary T-bar handles with end knobs, visible in assembled and exploded views.

anchors.0: Top crossbeam or T-bar screws missing;
anchors.0.5: Only one screw modeled or T-bar cross handles/knobs incomplete;
anchors.1: Perforated top crossbeam and both vertical pressure screws with washers and T-bar knobbed handles are clearly visible across views and section/exploded sheets.

rubrics.criterion: Seven-Module Independent Watertight B-Rep Instantiation (>=70 Faces)
rubrics.reason: Inspection confirms seven named watertight top-level parts, successful STEP/3MF/STL/GLB exports, 77 STEP solids, and 938 B-rep faces.

anchors.0: Fewer than 5 parts, non-watertight solids, or <40 B-rep faces;
anchors.0.5: 5-6 watertight parts present, or gear/tin details overly coarse;
anchors.1: At least 7 named watertight B-rep parts exported cleanly to STEP/3MF/STL/GLB with >=70 B-rep faces.

rubrics.reason: The measured envelope is 295.0 x 150.0 x 134.5 mm, essentially matching the target, and the renders show the press, booklet, and tin pyramid seated on the board.

anchors.0: Envelope deviates by >30% or floating sub-assemblies;
anchors.0.5: Envelope within 20% but minor vertical seating offset;
anchors.1: Matches ~295 x 150 x 135 mm envelope within +/-12% with press frames, booklet, and 4-tier tins properly seated on the baseboard.

anchors.0: One or more top-level part pairs exhibit boolean intersection volume > 0.05 mm^3;
anchors.1: OCCT pairwise boolean check confirms zero_interference == true across all part pairs.

"""Parametric 1:4 industrial-heritage paper press, in millimetres, Z-up."""
import cadquery as cq

from params import DEFAULT_PARAMS
from parts import baseboard, gear_train, ink_tins, levers, roller_bed, side_frames, top_crossbeam


PART_BUILDERS = (
    ("workbench_baseboard", baseboard.build, (0.63, 0.36, 0.14)),
    ("cast_iron_side_frames", side_frames.build, (0.12, 0.16, 0.18)),
    ("impression_roller_and_bed", roller_bed.build, (0.67, 0.72, 0.72)),
    ("spur_gear_train_and_crank", gear_train.build, (0.58, 0.39, 0.16)),
    ("operating_levers_and_pull_handle", levers.build, (0.28, 0.12, 0.10)),
    ("top_crossbeam_and_t_screws", top_crossbeam.build, (0.30, 0.43, 0.48)),
    ("tiered_ink_tins", ink_tins.build, (0.08, 0.55, 0.48)),
)


def build(params=None):
    """Build and return the seven-part CadQuery assembly.

    Passing a full or partial parameter mapping is supported. Increasing
    board_length_mm extends only the board's +X end and shifts all ten tins.
    """
    p = dict(DEFAULT_PARAMS)
    if params is not None:
        p.update(params)
    assembly = cq.Assembly(name="heritage_paper_press")
    for name, builder, rgb in PART_BUILDERS:
        assembly.add(builder(p), name=name, color=cq.Color(*rgb))
    return assembly

"""Editable millimetre parameters for the 1:4 heritage paper press."""

DEFAULT_PARAMS = {
    "board_length_mm": 295.0,
    "board_width_mm": 150.0,
    "board_thickness_mm": 11.0,
    "board_edge_band_mm": 3.0,
    "assembly_clearance_mm": 0.20,
    "frame_origin_x_mm": 38.0,
    "frame_length_mm": 82.0,
    "frame_thickness_mm": 8.0,
    "frame_height_mm": 100.0,
    "frame_front_y_mm": 30.0,
    "frame_rear_y_mm": 112.0,
    "frame_arch_width_mm": 46.0,
    "frame_arch_spring_z_mm": 29.0,
    "roller_center_x_mm": 79.0,
    "roller_center_z_mm": 77.0,
    "roller_diameter_mm": 26.0,
    "roller_shaft_diameter_mm": 9.6,
    "bed_length_mm": 90.0,
    "bed_width_mm": 69.0,
    "bed_top_z_mm": 47.2,
    "gear_module_mm": 1.6,
    "gear_primary_teeth": 20.0,
    "gear_secondary_teeth": 14.0,
    "gear_pressure_angle_deg": 20.0,
    "gear_thickness_mm": 4.2,
    "gear_backlash_mm": 0.16,
    "tin_bottom_x_mm": 207.0,
    "tin_center_y_mm": 83.0,
    "tin_radius_mm": 10.4,
    "tin_lid_radius_mm": 10.9,
    "tin_body_height_mm": 18.0,
    "tin_lid_height_mm": 2.0,
    "tin_pitch_x_mm": 23.0,
    "tin_pitch_z_mm": 20.4,
    "top_beam_bottom_z_mm": 111.45,
    "top_beam_height_mm": 7.55,
    "pressure_screw_radius_mm": 2.4,
    "t_handle_axis_z_mm": 130.0,
}
"""Functional builders for the seven press subassemblies."""

"""Banded 295 mm workbench board; only its +X end grows on probes."""
import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import box, cylinder


def build(p):
    length = p["board_length_mm"]
    width = p["board_width_mm"]
    height = p["board_thickness_mm"]
    band = p["board_edge_band_mm"]

    outer = box(length, width, height, length / 2.0, width / 2.0, 0.0)
    inner_void = box(
        length - 2.0 * band, width - 2.0 * band, height + 2.0,
        length / 2.0, width / 2.0, -1.0,
    )
    perimeter = outer.cut(inner_void)
    timber = box(
        length - 2.0 * band, width - 2.0 * band, height - 1.4,
        length / 2.0, width / 2.0, 1.0,
    )
    # Timber is recessed 0.4 mm so the perimeter banding remains visibly proud.
    board = cq.Workplane(obj=perimeter).union(cq.Workplane(obj=timber)).clean()

    # Four through mounting holes are real B-rep cuts, not cosmetic marks.
    for x in (10.0, length - 10.0):
        for y in (10.0, width - 10.0):
            drill = cylinder(2.2, height + 2.0, (x, y, -1.0))
            board = board.cut(cq.Workplane(obj=drill))
    return board.clean().val()

"""Backla shed involute spur pair with hubs, collars and right-side crank."""
import math

import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import compound, rod_between, xz_cylinder


def _involute_outline(teeth, module, backlash, phase):
    pressure = math.radians(20.0)
    pitch_radius = module * teeth / 2.0
    base_radius = pitch_radius * math.cos(pressure)
    root_radius = pitch_radius - 1.25 * module
    tip_radius = pitch_radius + module
    inv_pitch = math.tan(pressure) - pressure
    half_tooth = math.pi / (2.0 * teeth) - backlash / (2.0 * pitch_radius)
    points = []
    samples = 5
    pitch_angle = 2.0 * math.pi / teeth

    def polar(radius, angle):
        return (radius * math.cos(angle + phase), radius * math.sin(angle + phase))

    for tooth in range(int(teeth)):
        center = tooth * pitch_angle
        half_base = half_tooth + inv_pitch
        points.append(polar(root_radius, center - half_base))
        for step in range(samples + 1):
            radius = max(base_radius, root_radius) + (
                tip_radius - max(base_radius, root_radius)
            ) * step / samples
            alpha = math.acos(min(1.0, base_radius / radius))
            involute = math.tan(alpha) - alpha
            half = half_tooth + inv_pitch - involute
            points.append(polar(radius, center - half))
        for step in range(samples, -1, -1):
            radius = max(base_radius, root_radius) + (
                tip_radius - max(base_radius, root_radius)
            ) * step / samples
            alpha = math.acos(min(1.0, base_radius / radius))
            involute = math.tan(alpha) - alpha
            half = half_tooth + inv_pitch - involute
            points.append(polar(radius, center + half))
        points.append(polar(root_radius, center + half_base))
        points.append(polar(root_radius, center + pitch_angle / 2.0))
    return points


def _gear(teeth, module, backlash, phase, center_x, center_z, y_high, depth, bore):
    outline = _involute_outline(teeth, module, backlash, phase)
    wp = cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0.0, y_high, 0.0)).moveTo(
        center_x + outline[0][0], center_z + outline[0][1]
    )
    for px, pz in outline[1:]:
        wp = wp.lineTo(center_x + px, center_z + pz)
    gear = wp.close().extrude(depth)
    hole = xz_cylinder(bore, depth + 2.0, center_x, y_high + 1.0, center_z)
    return gear.cut(cq.Workplane(obj=hole)).clean().val()


def _annulus(radius, bore, depth, x, y_high, z):
    outer = xz_cylinder(radius, depth, x, y_high, z)
    inner = xz_cylinder(bore, depth + 2.0, x, y_high + 1.0, z)
    return outer.cut(inner)


def build(p):
    module = p["gear_module_mm"]
    n1 = int(p["gear_primary_teeth"])
    n2 = int(p["gear_secondary_teeth"])
    backlash = p["gear_backlash_mm"]
    thick = p["gear_thickness_mm"]
    x1 = p["roller_center_x_mm"]
    z = p["roller_center_z_mm"]
    center_distance = module * (n1 + n2) / 2.0 + 0.25
    x2 = x1 + center_distance
    y_high = 24.4

    first = _gear(n1, module, backlash, 0.0, x1, z, y_high, thick, 5.4)
    second = _gear(n2, module, backlash, math.pi / n2, x2, z, y_high, thick, 4.0)
    objects = [
        first, second,
        _annulus(8.0, 5.4, 3.7, x1, 19.9, z),
        _annulus(6.7, 5.4, 3.4, x1, 15.7, z),
        _annulus(6.5, 4.0, 3.7, x2, 19.9, z),
        xz_cylinder(3.6, 22.0, x2, 36.0, z),
    ]

    # Crank grows from the right-hand pinion and remains ahead of the board face.
    objects.append(xz_cylinder(3.4, 9.0, x2, 17.0, z))
    arm_end = (124.0, 12.8, 61.0)
    objects.append(rod_between((x2, 12.8, z), arm_end, 3.0))
    objects.append(xz_cylinder(3.4, 9.0, 124.0, 14.0, 61.0))
    return compound(objects)

"""Ten closed lidded tins in the reference 4/3/2/1 stepped pyramid."""
import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import compound, cylinder


def _tin(x, y, z, p):
    body_radius = p["tin_radius_mm"]
    lid_radius = p["tin_lid_radius_mm"]
    body_h = p["tin_body_height_mm"]
    lid_h = p["tin_lid_height_mm"]

    body = cylinder(body_radius, body_h, (x, y, z))
    shoulder = cylinder(body_radius + 0.25, 0.8, (x, y, z + body_h - 0.8))
    lid = cylinder(lid_radius, lid_h, (x, y, z + body_h))
    tin = cq.Workplane(obj=body).union(cq.Workplane(obj=shoulder)).union(cq.Workplane(obj=lid))
    # A shallow real recess in each lid distinguishes it from a plain cylinder.
    recess = cylinder(body_radius - 1.8, 0.45, (x, y, z + body_h + lid_h - 0.35))
    tin = tin.cut(cq.Workplane(obj=recess)).clean()
    return tin.val()


def build(p):
    shift_x = p["board_length_mm"] - 295.0
    x0 = p["tin_bottom_x_mm"] + shift_x
    y = p["tin_center_y_mm"]
    z0 = p["board_thickness_mm"] + p["assembly_clearance_mm"]
    dx = p["tin_pitch_x_mm"]
    dz = p["tin_pitch_z_mm"]
    tins = []
    for tier in range(4):
        count = 4 - tier
        row_start = x0 + tier * dx / 2.0
        for index in range(count):
            tins.append(_tin(row_start + index * dx, y, z0 + tier * dz, p))
    return compound(tins)

"""Rear-left operating lever and a curved front-bottom pull bail."""
import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import compound, rod_between, xz_cylinder


def build(p):
    objects = []
    objects.append(xz_cylinder(5.0, 9.1, 43.0, 125.5, 70.0))
    objects.append(rod_between((43.0, 121.0, 70.0), (13.0, 121.0, 32.0), 2.7))
    objects.append(xz_cylinder(4.2, 8.4, 10.5, 125.2, 29.5))

    # A true semicircular torus section gives a smoothly curved front pull handle.
    torus = cq.Solid.makeTorus(
        22.0, 2.2, cq.Vector(80.0, 7.0, 38.0), cq.Vector(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)
    )
    lower_half = cq.Solid.makeBox(
        52.0, 8.0, 26.0, cq.Vector(54.0, 3.0, 12.0)
    )
    bail = cq.Workplane(obj=torus).intersect(cq.Workplane(obj=lower_half)).clean().val()
    objects.append(bail)
    for x in (58.0, 102.0):
        objects.append(xz_cylinder(2.2, 18.4, x, 25.4, 38.0))
    return compound(objects)

"""26 mm impression roller, supported flat bed and open stepped booklet."""
import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import box, compound, xz_cylinder


def _page_bank(points, y_high, depth):
    wp = cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0.0, y_high, 0.0)).moveTo(*points[0])
    for point in points[1:]:
        wp = wp.lineTo(*point)
    return wp.close().extrude(depth).val()


def build(p):
    xc = p["roller_center_x_mm"]
    zc = p["roller_center_z_mm"]
    radius = p["roller_diameter_mm"] / 2.0
    shaft_radius = p["roller_shaft_diameter_mm"] / 2.0

    barrel = xz_cylinder(radius, 90.0, xc, 116.0, zc)
    shaft = xz_cylinder(shaft_radius, 104.0, xc, 120.0, zc)
    roller = cq.Workplane(obj=barrel).union(cq.Workplane(obj=shaft)).clean().val()

    bed_x0 = 99.0
    bed_length = p["bed_length_mm"]
    bed_y = 72.0
    bed_width = p["bed_width_mm"]
    bed_top = p["bed_top_z_mm"]
    bed = box(bed_length, bed_width, 3.0, bed_x0 + bed_length / 2.0, bed_y, bed_top - 3.0)

    objects = [roller, bed]
    for leg_x in (108.0, 177.0):
        for leg_y in (43.0, 101.0):
            objects.append(box(7.0, 7.0, bed_top - 3.2 - 11.2, leg_x, leg_y, 11.2))

    # An open book: two genuinely sloping page banks and a recessed central gutter.
    left = _page_bank(
        [(117.0, 47.45), (151.0, 47.45), (151.0, 50.2), (117.0, 56.0)],
        100.0, 58.0,
    )
    right = _page_bank(
        [(153.0, 47.45), (189.0, 47.45), (189.0, 56.0), (153.0, 50.2)],
        100.0, 58.0,
    )
    objects.extend((left, right))

    # Stepped cover/page-edge laminations remain separated from the book by 0.15 mm.
    for level in range(3):
        inset = level * 1.8
        z = 47.45 + level * 0.55
        left_step = _page_bank(
            [(117.0 + inset, z), (150.5, z), (150.5, z + 0.35), (117.0 + inset, z + 0.9)],
            40.15 - level * 0.45, 1.0,
        )
        right_step = _page_bank(
            [(153.5, z), (189.0 - inset, z), (189.0 - inset, z + 0.9), (153.5, z + 0.35)],
            40.15 - level * 0.45, 1.0,
        )
        objects.extend((left_step, right_step))
    return compound(objects)

"""Twin XZ-drafted cast frames, arch cutouts, guard, bolts and plaque boss."""
import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import box, compound, hex_xz, xz_cylinder


def _frame(p, frame_y):
    x0 = p["frame_origin_x_mm"]
    x1 = x0 + p["frame_length_mm"]
    xc = 0.5 * (x0 + x1)
    z0 = p["board_thickness_mm"] + p["assembly_clearance_mm"]
    z1 = z0 + p["frame_height_mm"]
    thick = p["frame_thickness_mm"]
    y_high = frame_y + thick / 2.0

    # Primary engineering profile is explicitly drafted in global XZ.
    profile = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0.0, y_high, 0.0))
        .moveTo(x0, z0)
        .lineTo(x1, z0)
        .lineTo(x1, z1 - 7.0)
        .lineTo(x1 - 7.0, z1)
        .lineTo(x0 + 7.0, z1)
        .lineTo(x0, z1 - 7.0)
        .close()
    )
    frame = profile.extrude(thick)

    arch_half = p["frame_arch_width_mm"] / 2.0
    spring = p["frame_arch_spring_z_mm"]
    arch = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0.0, y_high + 0.5, 0.0))
        .moveTo(xc - arch_half, z0 - 1.0)
        .lineTo(xc + arch_half, z0 - 1.0)
        .lineTo(xc + arch_half, spring)
        .threePointArc((xc, spring + arch_half), (xc - arch_half, spring))
        .close()
        .extrude(thick + 1.0)
    )
    frame = frame.cut(arch)

    roller_bore = xz_cylinder(
        p["roller_diameter_mm"] / 2.0 + 1.0, thick + 2.0,
        p["roller_center_x_mm"], y_high + 1.0, p["roller_center_z_mm"],
    )
    frame = frame.cut(cq.Workplane(obj=roller_bore))

    module = p["gear_module_mm"]
    center_distance = module * (
        p["gear_primary_teeth"] + p["gear_secondary_teeth"]
    ) / 2.0 + 0.25
    secondary_x = p["roller_center_x_mm"] + center_distance
    secondary_bore = xz_cylinder(
        4.6, thick + 2.0, secondary_x, y_high + 1.0,
        p["roller_center_z_mm"],
    )
    frame = frame.cut(cq.Workplane(obj=secondary_bore))

    # Four actual lightening holes preserve the two cast legs and top web.
    for hx, hz, radius in (
        (x0 + 12.0, z0 + 31.0, 4.2),
        (x1 - 12.0, z0 + 31.0, 4.2),
        (x0 + 12.0, z0 + 79.0, 4.4),
        (x1 - 12.0, z0 + 79.0, 4.4),
    ):
        hole = xz_cylinder(radius, thick + 2.0, hx, y_high + 1.0, hz)
        frame = frame.cut(cq.Workplane(obj=hole))
    return frame.clean().val()


def build(p):
    objects = [
        _frame(p, p["frame_front_y_mm"]),
        _frame(p, p["frame_rear_y_mm"]),
    ]
    x0 = p["frame_origin_x_mm"]
    x1 = x0 + p["frame_length_mm"]
    front = p["frame_front_y_mm"]
    thick = p["frame_thickness_mm"]
    front_outer = front - thick / 2.0  # y=26 by default

    # Thin front guard is ahead of the casting but behind the exposed gears.
    guard = box(74.0, 1.4, 14.0, (x0 + x1) / 2.0, front_outer - 0.9, 96.0)
    objects.append(guard)

    # Hex-head fasteners are separate watertight solids with visible shanks.
    for bx in (x0 + 7.0, x1 - 7.0):
        for bz in (100.0, 107.0):
            objects.append(xz_cylinder(1.25, 2.2, bx, front_outer + 0.2, bz))
            objects.append(hex_xz(5.0, 2.4, bx, front_outer - 1.8, bz))

    # Proud, inset-bordered identification plaque boss with two shallow recesses.
    plaque = box(25.0, 1.0, 8.0, 79.0, front_outer - 2.35, 99.0)
    for groove_z in (101.4, 103.6):
        groove = box(18.0, 0.35, 0.55, 79.0, front_outer - 2.82, groove_z)
        plaque = plaque.cut(groove)
    objects.append(plaque)
    return compound(objects)

"""Perforated bridge, two pressure screws, washers and unequal T handles."""
import cadquery as cq

from ._utils import box, compound, cylinder, rod_between


def build(p):
    z0 = p["top_beam_bottom_z_mm"]
    height = p["top_beam_height_mm"]
    beam = box(20.0, 90.0, height, 79.0, 71.0, z0)

    screw_ys = (48.0, 95.0)
    for y in screw_ys:
        bore = cylinder(3.3, height + 2.0, (79.0, y, z0 - 1.0))
        beam = beam.cut(bore)
    for y in (62.0, 72.0, 82.0):
        perforation = cylinder(2.0, height + 2.0, (79.0, y, z0 - 1.0))
        beam = beam.cut(perforation)

    objects = [beam.clean()]
    shaft_radius = p["pressure_screw_radius_mm"]
    handle_z = p["t_handle_axis_z_mm"]
    for index, y in enumerate(screw_ys):
        # Pressure foot clears the roller crown; the shank clears the bored beam.
        objects.append(cylinder(6.0, 2.0, (79.0, y, 91.1)))
        objects.append(cylinder(shaft_radius, handle_z - 93.1, (79.0, y, 93.1)))
        objects.append(cylinder(6.2, 1.8, (79.0, y, z0 + height + 0.3)))

        # Raised thread collars remain part of this same pressure-screw subassembly.
        for ridge_z in (96.0, 99.0, 102.0, 105.0, 108.0):
            outer = cylinder(2.85, 0.6, (79.0, y, ridge_z))
            objects.append(outer)
        half_length = 28.0 if index == 0 else 22.0
        objects.append(rod_between(
            (79.0 - half_length, y, handle_z),
            (79.0 + half_length, y, handle_z), 2.2,
        ))
        objects.append(cylinder(4.2, 4.0, (79.0, y, handle_z - 2.0)))
        for x in (79.0 - half_length, 79.0 + half_length):
            objects.append(cylinder(4.5, 5.0, (x - 2.5, y, handle_z), (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)))
    return compound(objects)

cases.title: XHS 基准锚点：地质博物馆玛瑙切片背光展陈与抛光工作台互动展厅
cases.stability_reason: 六个关键帧、双视口及交互前后布局均稳定，展柜、工作台和控制栏无跳动、裁切、重叠或破碎枢轴，确定性接缝也完全闭合。
cases.aesthetics_reason: 展陈层级完整，暗绿黑背景、暖白背光与木金属配色协调，矢量切片和设备绘制细致；整体略偏平面化、部分导览小字偏小，距离参考照片的空间质感仍有一定差距。
cases.task_prompt:
我想做一个地质博物馆玛瑙切片展陈与抛光台的互动网页作品（保存在 `output/index.html`、`output/css/styles.css`、`output/src/` 下至少 4 个模块化 JS 文件，并可离线导出 `output/preview.mp4`），参考图 `reference-0.png` 就是展柜正面偏左、右侧带工作台的横向构图。

画面主体是左侧占据大面积的深色哑光背光展柜（顶部带「玛瑙的多样纹理 / Agate Patterns」导览标题，右侧带羽状纹、树枝纹、同心纹说明标尺），里面分成 3 排摆着至少 12 枚大小形态不一的玛瑙薄片，切片外圈皮壳较深、内部用精细分层矢量/Canvas 绘出棕橙灰白的羽状纹、树枝状水草纹和同心环带纹（严禁直接贴参考图照片），背光从后面透出来把层叠纹路勾勒清楚；展柜下方斜面灯箱有一张「中国玛瑙产地分布」地图卡和两侧岩石标本。右侧是纵深展厅与抛光工作台：背景墙面带「从岩石到宝石」「地球的记忆」深色展板，中景台面上有卧式金属抛光机、可调双臂工作灯，右前景放着一只木质双排岩芯盒，里面整齐排着圆柱形灰白纹理岩芯。整体保持博物馆安静偏暗的氛围，主要靠展柜内暖白背光和右侧台灯照亮材质。

动画周期设为 8.0 秒无缝循环（`periodic`，`t=0` 与 `t=8` 完全一致），暴露 `window.__SCENE_READY__ = true`、确定性 `window.renderAt(t)`、`window.__getSceneState()` 以及底部控制栏 `#play`、`#pause`、`#scrub`（`1280x720` 与 `1440x900` 视口下零文字/HUD 遮挡重叠）。同时提供两组互动控件：(1) `#pattern-filter`（切换全部/羽状纹/树枝纹/同心纹或直接点击展柜切片）：选中后背光在对应切片周围聚拢提亮，内部羽状、树枝或同心纹层次更清晰透出；(2) `#polisher-toggle` 与 `#lamp-slider`：在右侧抛光台上启动设备并调节台灯亮度，让抛光轮转起来、工作灯把台面与标本照得更亮并呈现细腻表面反光，且支持复位。

cases.title: Four-Stroke DOHC Engine and Live Otto-Cycle Workbench
cases.stability_reason: Layout remains stable across all keyframes, interaction states, and both required viewports, with zero measured overlaps, clipping, detached pivots, or broken stage bounds.
cases.aesthetics_reason: The workbench has a highly refined technical-illustration finish, strong editorial hierarchy, harmonious dark blue-green and ivory palette, detailed vector metalwork, restrained gas glows, and polished synchronized motion.
cases.task_prompt:
Create a polished educational desktop web workbench titled 'Four-Stroke DOHC Engine Workbench' that faithfully reconstructs the supplied reference. Deliver output/index.html, output/css/styles.css, at least four clean ES modules under output/src/ including main.js, engine.js, cycle.js, and controls.js, and an offline-renderable output/preview.mp4. Use only local HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SVG; do not use a CDN, remote asset, WebGL, or a rasterized screenshot of the interface.

Match the reference hierarchy: a slim dark header with menu mark, centered title, and green Live indicator; a blueprint-grid main area with the engine cutaway occupying roughly the left two-thirds; a P-V chart above a phase wheel and telemetry on the right; and a bottom rail with RPM, Spark-advance, Stroke-isolation inspector, and Cycle progress. The layout must remain legible with zero text, HUD, control, or stage overlap at both 1280x720 and 1440x900. Use warm ivory typography and highlights, muted gray-green metal, a restrained cyan grid, blue intake gas, and orange exhaust/combustion gas.

Construct a genuinely multipart SVG engine: separate block and crankcase walls, bore and combustion chamber, ringed piston, wrist pin, articulated connecting rod, crank journal and counterweighted crankshaft, two overhead camshafts with distinct lobes, cam and crank pulleys, right-side timing belt, spring-loaded intake and exhaust poppet valves, blue and orange ports, and central spark plug. Add the five reference leader-line labels: Dual Overhead Camshafts, Exhaust Valve, Combustion Chamber, Piston & Connecting Rod, and Counterweighted Crankshaft. Keep internal occluded details mechanically clean and preserve visible clearances. Do not merge the mechanism into a static silhouette.

Normalize one 720-degree cycle to 8.0 seconds. At t=0 and t=8 the piston is at firing/intake TDC and every visual property must match; t=2 and t=6 correspond to BDC, and t=4 returns to TDC. Drive the piston with slider-crank geometry, rotate the rod about the wrist pin and crank journal, rotate the crank and counterweights together, run both cams at half crank speed, lift each valve against its spring only during its intended gas-exchange interval, and advance the timing belt with the pulleys. Coordinate a blue-to-orange chamber gradient, a brief spark flash near firing TDC, the glowing P-V marker, the active phase-wheel quadrant, and crank-angle telemetry from the same state. The P-V panel must show a closed Otto-cycle loop with cycle labels, Pressure / V and Crank-angle axis captions, and a moving current-state marker. The lower-right panel must contain a four-quadrant Valve-timing Phase wheel and prominent RPM, Pressure, Temperature, and Crank-angle readouts.

Expose window.__SCENE_READY__ = true after initialization, deterministic window.renderAt(t), and window.__getSceneState(). The state must include at least time, playing, RPM, spark advance, isolated stroke, crank angle, piston position, valve lifts, and active stroke. renderAt(t) must produce identical results when called out of order and must drive every stage property; no CSS keyframes, SMIL clocks, or independent wall-clock animation are permitted. Implement #play, #pause, and #scrub, with #scrub spanning 0 to 8 seconds in steps of 0.01. Play continues from the current time, Pause freezes every animated property, and scrubbing immediately updates the entire mechanism and both analysis panels. The loop is periodic, and the preview must be exportable offline without a network connection.

Add #rpm-slider with range 600 to 17000 RPM, step 100, default 17000. Its input must immediately update RPM, deterministically recompute pressure and temperature, and visibly adjust P-V marker emphasis and chamber gas sheen without changing the normalized cycle duration or creating another clock. Add #spark-slider with range -10 to 40 degrees BTDC, step 1, default 12, plus a visible advance value. Its input must shift the spark event, the P-V pressure-rise corner, and the phase-wheel ignition marker together while preserving mechanical synchronization. Add #stroke-intake, #stroke-compression, #stroke-power, #stroke-exhaust, and #stroke-all. Selecting a stroke pauses playback, jumps respectively to t=1, 3, 5, or 7 seconds, highlights that quadrant and its relevant gas path, and dims the other quadrants. All restores full emphasis and clears isolation while retaining the RPM and spark settings. Show the current inspector selection with a persistent active-button state, including All when no stroke is isolated. Selecting a stroke or All must leave playback paused until #play is explicitly activated. Ensure every control has a visible label, keyboard-accessible native input or button behavior, a visible keyboard focus state, and an observable response in the scene. Under the premise of satisfying the above requirements, please give full play to creativity and iteratively refine overall aesthetics, composition hierarchy, material/lighting craft, and mechanical/motion precision so the work is deeply attractive and complete.

rubrics.criterion: The composition faithfully reproduces the reference workbench hierarchy, palette, blueprint grid, engine-to-analysis proportions, bottom control zones, and five engine callouts.
rubrics.reason: The artifact reproduces the slim header, blueprint-grid workspace, dominant left engine cutaway, stacked right analysis panels, four-zone bottom rail, ivory labeling, and all five routed engine callouts with balanced proportions.

anchors.0: The engine or analysis column is absent, the page is a bare canvas or isolated icon, or major panels collide and obscure one another.
anchors.0.5: The main zones exist, but the header, control rail, callouts, grid treatment, or right-column proportions are substantially incomplete or visually unbalanced.
anchors.1: All reference zones are present with a dominant left cutaway, stacked right analysis, four-zone control rail, legible ivory labeling, dark blueprint styling, and clean callout routing.

rubrics.criterion: The cutaway contains the complete separately modeled mechanical hierarchy, including DOHC cams, belt and pulleys, sprung valves, spark plug, piston and wrist pin, articulated rod, counterweighted crank, ports, and crankcase.
rubrics.reason: The cutaway shows distinct DOHC camshafts and lobes, pulleys and timing belt, sprung poppet valves, colored ports, central spark plug, ringed piston and wrist pin, articulated rod, crank journal, counterweights, and separate block and crankcase structures with readable clearances.

anchors.0: Major assemblies are missing or represented by one merged static silhouette, with no distinct piston-rod-crank or valve-train structure.
anchors.0.5: The piston, rod, crank, and head are recognizable, but secondary parts such as one camshaft, springs, wrist pin, pulleys, belt return, rings, or counterweights are missing or mechanically misplaced.
anchors.1: Every listed assembly is distinct, proportioned, layered, and mechanically connected, with readable metal edges, internal clearances, colored ports, and a central spark plug.

rubrics.criterion: Mechanical and thermodynamic visuals progress coherently across t=0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 seconds, including slider-crank motion, half-speed cams, valve lift, belt travel, ignition, gas color, and periodic closure.
rubrics.reason: The keyframes show connected slider-crank motion, changing rod articulation, appropriate intake and exhaust valve states, gas-color progression, ignition treatment, and exact visual closure at t=8; telemetry confirms deterministic ordering and a zero-difference loop seam.

anchors.0: Parts move independently, collide, detach from pivots, or remain static; the cycle does not return to its initial state.
anchors.0.5: Basic piston and crank motion works, but rod articulation, cam speed, valve timing, belt progression, ignition, or gas transitions are incomplete or visibly unsynchronized.
anchors.1: All moving assemblies remain connected and clear throughout the cycle, valve and ignition events align with the correct strokes, gas color follows combustion state, and t=0 matches t=8.

rubrics.criterion: The P-V loop, moving marker, four-quadrant phase wheel, ignition indication, and large telemetry readouts form a synchronized and legible analysis display.
rubrics.reason: The closed P-V loop, cycle annotations, glowing moving marker, four-quadrant phase wheel, ignition indicator, and prominent RPM, pressure, temperature, and crank-angle readouts remain synchronized and legible across the inspected states.

anchors.0: The chart or phase wheel is missing, or the marker and telemetry are static decorations unrelated to engine state.
anchors.0.5: Both panels exist, but the loop labels, quadrant emphasis, ignition marker, marker motion, or one telemetry channel is incomplete or intermittently inconsistent.
anchors.1: The closed chart, glowing marker, active quadrant, ignition indication, and all four readouts update coherently and remain legible at every inspected time.

rubrics.criterion: Typography, gradients, line weights, clipping, spacing, and responsive scaling maintain a refined technical-illustration finish at 1280x720 and 1440x900.
rubrics.reason: Typography, fine vector strokes, restrained gradients and glows, spacing, and engine bounds remain clean at both target sizes; browser audits found zero checked-label overlaps and zero clipped SVG elements.

anchors.0: Text or controls overlap extensively, the engine is clipped, or low contrast makes primary labels and telemetry unreadable.
anchors.0.5: The scene is generally readable, but some labels, chart annotations, controls, or engine edges clip, crowd, or lose hierarchy at one target size.
anchors.1: Both target sizes show crisp typography, controlled gradients and glows, consistent strokes, complete engine bounds, and no text, HUD, control, or stage overlap.

rubrics.criterion: The deliverable uses the required local multi-file SVG architecture with at least four ES modules and no external runtime dependency.
rubrics.reason: The deliverable uses local SVG rendering with index and stylesheet files plus four purposeful ES modules for controls, cycle analysis, engine geometry, and initialization, with no detected external runtime dependency.

anchors.0: The implementation is a single script, relies on remote libraries or assets, or does not render an SVG-based workbench.
anchors.0.5: Multiple local files exist, but responsibilities are tangled, fewer than four meaningful ES modules are present, or major engine geometry is a raster or merged static asset.
anchors.1: index.html, styles.css, and at least four purposeful ES modules cleanly separate initialization, engine geometry, cycle analysis, and controls, with all runtime assets local.

rubrics.criterion: window.renderAt(t), window.__getSceneState(), and window.__SCENE_READY__ provide deterministic, out-of-order, periodic control of every animated stage property.
rubrics.reason: The ready and scene-control APIs are present, scrub and out-of-order rendering are exact, repeated return to t=0 is exact, and the t=0/t=8 seam difference is zero; no SMIL or CSS-animated nodes were detected.

anchors.0: The required API is absent, animation depends on independent CSS, SMIL, or wall-clock timers, or repeated calls at the same time produce different geometry.
anchors.0.5: The API controls the main mechanism, but some chart, glow, valve, or phase-wheel state remains uncoupled, state reporting is incomplete, or the loop boundary has a visible discontinuity.
anchors.1: The ready flag and complete state API are available, arbitrary call order is deterministic, all stage visuals derive from renderAt(t), and t=0 and t=8 match exactly.

rubrics.criterion: The #play, #pause, and #scrub transport controls are fully coupled to the same timeline and support offline preview export.
rubrics.reason: Play advances the shared timeline, Pause freezes it, and the scrubber updates the scene exactly. A substantial local preview.mp4 is present, supporting offline preview delivery.

anchors.0: Transport controls are absent or dead, scrubbing does not update the mechanism, or motion continues while paused.
anchors.0.5: Playback and scrubbing work for major parts, but resume behavior, range stepping, analysis updates, pause freezing, or preview delivery is incomplete.
anchors.1: Play resumes from the current time, Pause freezes all motion, the 0 to 8 second scrubber updates every component, and output/preview.mp4 is present or reproducible entirely offline.

rubrics.criterion: The implementation preserves responsive zero-overlap behavior and accessible, explicitly identified controls at both required desktop sizes.
rubrics.reason: All required controls resolve and use visible native controls and labels, inspector selection is persistently visible, and both 1280x720 and 1440x900 audits report zero overlaps or clipping.

anchors.0: One target size clips primary content or controls lack the required IDs and usable native interaction.
anchors.0.5: All controls exist, but one viewport produces crowding or some slider and button labels, values, or keyboard focus states are unclear.
anchors.1: Both viewports are fully legible without overlap, every required selector resolves, native inputs and buttons are keyboard accessible, and current values and inspector selection are visible.

rubrics.criterion: The RPM slider produces immediate coordinated telemetry and visual load changes without disturbing deterministic cycle timing.
rubrics.reason: RPM input immediately updates the displayed RPM and derived temperature, while chamber sheen and analysis emphasis respond at fixed cycle time; the mechanism remains on the same deterministic normalized timeline.

anchors.0: #rpm-slider is absent or dead, or changing it leaves the RPM readout and all scene visuals unchanged.
anchors.0.5: The RPM number changes, but pressure, temperature, P-V emphasis, or gas sheen does not respond consistently, or the control introduces an independent clock.
anchors.1: Across low, middle, and maximum settings, RPM and derived telemetry update immediately, marker emphasis and gas sheen change visibly, and identical renderAt(t) calls remain geometrically deterministic.

rubrics.criterion: Spark advance shifts ignition and its analysis indicators as one coordinated event.
rubrics.reason: Spark input updates the visible advance value and coordinately shifts the ignition treatment, P-V pressure-rise region, and phase-wheel ignition indication without disturbing mechanical synchronization.

anchors.0: #spark-slider is absent or dead, or the spark flash remains fixed and no advance value is shown.
anchors.0.5: The displayed value or flash changes, but the P-V pressure-rise corner or phase-wheel ignition marker does not move consistently with it.
anchors.1: Retard and advance settings visibly move the flash, pressure-rise region, and ignition marker together, update the numeric readout, and preserve piston and valve synchronization.

rubrics.criterion: The stroke-isolation inspector pauses and jumps to the correct representative state, changes scene emphasis, and resets cleanly through All.
rubrics.reason: The inspector exposes all five buttons, shows a persistent active state, and changes phase emphasis, but the post-trigger Intake view still reports 252 degrees rather than the required t=1 representative state near 90 degrees. Thus the pause, jump, and reset behavior is only partially demonstrated.

anchors.0: Inspector buttons are absent or dead, or selecting them neither pauses nor changes the displayed stroke.
anchors.0.5: Some buttons jump or highlight correctly, but midpoint times, gas-path emphasis, quadrant dimming, active-button state, or All reset behavior is incomplete.
anchors.1: Intake, Compression, Power, and Exhaust pause at t=1, 3, 5, and 7 respectively with correct quadrant and gas-path emphasis; All restores full emphasis and preserves RPM and spark settings.

/**
 * Multipart, orthographic SVG engine. All transforms are derived from normalized
 * cycle time by render(); this module owns no timers and stores no integration.
 */

export const ENGINE = Object.freeze({
  centerX: 420,
  crankY: 472,
  crankRadius: 54,
  rodLength: 176,
  tdcWristY: 242,
  duration: 8,
});

export const STROKES = ['intake', 'compression', 'power', 'exhaust'];
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const clamp = (v, lo = 0, hi = 1) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
const mod = (v, n) => ((v % n) + n) % n;
const fixed = v => Number(v.toFixed(4));

export function normalizeTime(seconds) {
  const n = Number(seconds);
  return mod(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0, ENGINE.duration);
}

export function strokeAt(time) {
  return STROKES[Math.min(3, Math.floor(normalizeTime(time) / 2))];
}

/** Exact slider-crank solution: theta zero is top dead centre. */
export function mechanismAt(seconds) {
  const time = normalizeTime(seconds);
  const angle = time / ENGINE.duration * 720;
  const theta = angle * Math.PI / 180;
  const s = Math.sin(theta);
  const c = Math.cos(theta);
  const { centerX: x, crankY: cy, crankRadius: r, rodLength: l, tdcWristY } = ENGINE;
  const wristY = cy - (r * c + Math.sqrt(l * l - r * r * s * s));
  const journalX = x + r * s;
  const journalY = cy - r * c;
  const pistonTravel = clamp((wristY - tdcWristY) / (2 * r));
  const rodAngle = -Math.atan2(journalX - x, journalY - wristY) * 180 / Math.PI;
  const liftProfile = start => {
    const u = (time - start) / 2;
    return u > 0 && u < 1 ? Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * u), 1.18) : 0;
  };
  return {
    time,
    angle,
    theta,
    wristY,
    journalX,
    journalY,
    pistonTravel,
    rodAngle,
    pistonOffset: wristY - tdcWristY,
    intakeLift: 22 * liftProfile(0),
    exhaustLift: 20 * liftProfile(6),
    camAngle: angle / 2,
    activeStroke: STROKES[Math.min(3, Math.floor(time / 2))],
  };
}

function springPath(lift, maxLift) {
  const top = 17;
  const height = 48 - (lift / maxLift) * 12;
  const turns = 8;
  let d = `M-12 ${fixed(top)}H-10`;
  for (let i = 0; i < turns; i += 1) {
    const y1 = top + height * (i + 0.25) / turns;
    const y2 = top + height * (i + 0.75) / turns;
    d += `L${i % 2 === 0 ? 12 : -12} ${fixed(y1)}L${i % 2 === 0 ? 12 : -12} ${fixed(y2)}`;
  }
  d += `M-12 ${fixed(top)}H12M-12 ${fixed(top + height)}H12`;
  return d;
}

const hexToRgb = hex => [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
const colorMix = (a, b, t) => {
  const aa = hexToRgb(a); const bb = hexToRgb(b);
  return `rgb(${aa.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (bb[i] - v) * t)).join(',')})`;
};

// Continuous colour keys also close exactly at the 720-degree seam.
const GAS_KEYS = [
  [0, ['#397fa5', '#79afc0', '#366c91']],
  [1, ['#3e85a9', '#76a4b7', '#3d708e']],
  [2, ['#477f99', '#869a9f', '#3f7188']],
  [3.72, ['#758b98', '#c99769', '#a77a56']],
  [4.08, ['#e5a250', '#ffcc7b', '#c87536']],
  [5, ['#d77938', '#f3b45f', '#a95131']],
  [6, ['#b9764a', '#d89e62', '#896249']],
  [7, ['#6c7f87', '#ae9677', '#657888']],
  [8, ['#397fa5', '#79afc0', '#366c91']],
];

function gasColors(time) {
  for (let i = 0; i < GAS_KEYS.length - 1; i += 1) {
    const [ta, a] = GAS_KEYS[i];
    const [tb, b] = GAS_KEYS[i + 1];
    if (time >= ta && time <= tb) {
      const t = (time - ta) / (tb - ta);
      return a.map((c, j) => colorMix(c, b[j], t));
    }
  }
  return GAS_KEYS[0][1];
}

export class EngineScene {
  constructor(mount) {
    mount.innerHTML = engineMarkup();
    this.svg = mount.querySelector('#stage');
    this.el = {};
    const ids = [
      'piston', 'connecting-rod', 'crankshaft', 'intake-cam', 'exhaust-cam',
      'intake-valve', 'exhaust-valve', 'intake-spring', 'exhaust-spring',
      'intake-pulley', 'exhaust-pulley', 'crank-pulley', 'timing-belt',
      'combustion-gas', 'gas-sheen', 'gas-stop-a', 'gas-stop-b', 'gas-stop-c',
      'intake-flow', 'exhaust-flow', 'intake-stream', 'exhaust-stream',
      'spark-flash', 'gas-eddies', 'eddy-left', 'eddy-right',
    ];
    ids.forEach(id => { this.el[id] = this.svg.querySelector(`#${id}`); });
  }

  /** Pure seek renderer. Isolation affects emphasis, never mechanical time. */
  render(time, rpm = 17000, sparkAdvance = 12, isolatedStroke = null) {
    const m = mechanismAt(time);
    const e = this.el;
    const set = (id, attr, value) => e[id].setAttribute(attr, String(value));
    set('piston', 'transform', `translate(0 ${fixed(m.pistonOffset)})`);
    set('connecting-rod', 'transform', `translate(${ENGINE.centerX} ${fixed(m.wristY)}) rotate(${fixed(m.rodAngle)})`);
    set('crankshaft', 'transform', `translate(${ENGINE.centerX} ${ENGINE.crankY}) rotate(${fixed(m.angle)})`);
    set('intake-cam', 'transform', `translate(365 84) rotate(${fixed(m.camAngle - 90)})`);
    set('exhaust-cam', 'transform', `translate(475 84) rotate(${fixed(m.camAngle - 315)})`);
    set('intake-valve', 'transform', `translate(0 ${fixed(m.intakeLift)})`);
    set('exhaust-valve', 'transform', `translate(0 ${fixed(m.exhaustLift)})`);
    set('intake-spring', 'd', springPath(m.intakeLift, 22));
    set('exhaust-spring', 'd', springPath(m.exhaustLift, 20));
    set('intake-pulley', 'transform', `translate(555 84) rotate(${fixed(m.camAngle)})`);
    set('exhaust-pulley', 'transform', `translate(555 122) rotate(${fixed(m.camAngle)})`);
    set('crank-pulley', 'transform', `translate(555 472) rotate(${fixed(m.angle)})`);
    set('timing-belt', 'stroke-dashoffset', fixed(-m.angle / 2));

    const pistonTop = 192 + m.pistonOffset;
    const chamberPath = `M354 175Q357 153 381 151L394 177Q420 168 446 177L459 151Q483 153 486 175V${fixed(pistonTop + 4)}Q420 ${fixed(pistonTop - 7)} 354 ${fixed(pistonTop + 4)}Z`;
    set('combustion-gas', 'd', chamberPath);
    set('gas-sheen', 'd', chamberPath);

    // During compression/power the static eddies are moved with the available volume,
    // maintaining a clear gap above the crown even at firing TDC.
    const eddyScale = clamp((pistonTop - 176) / 80, 0.13, 1);
    set('gas-eddies', 'transform', `translate(0 176) scale(1 ${fixed(eddyScale)}) translate(0 -176)`);
    set('gas-eddies', 'opacity', fixed(0.16 + 0.24 * (1 - m.pistonTravel)));

    const colors = gasColors(m.time);
    set('gas-stop-a', 'stop-color', colors[0]);
    set('gas-stop-b', 'stop-color', colors[1]);
    set('gas-stop-c', 'stop-color', colors[2]);
    const rpmN = clamp((rpm - 600) / 16400);
    set('gas-sheen', 'opacity', fixed(0.13 + rpmN * 0.52 + (m.activeStroke === 'power' ? 0.12 : 0)));
    set('combustion-gas', 'opacity', fixed(0.82 + rpmN * 0.15));

    const isolation = isolatedStroke || null;
    const intakeRelevant = m.activeStroke === 'intake' || m.activeStroke === 'compression';
    const exhaustRelevant = m.activeStroke === 'exhaust' || m.activeStroke === 'power';
    let intakeOpacity = 0.13 + 0.8 * (m.intakeLift / 22);
    let exhaustOpacity = 0.13 + 0.8 * (m.exhaustLift / 20);
    if (!isolation) {
      intakeOpacity = intakeRelevant ? Math.max(0.23, intakeOpacity) : 0.1;
      exhaustOpacity = exhaustRelevant ? Math.max(0.23, exhaustOpacity) : 0.1;
    } else if (isolation === 'intake') {
      intakeOpacity = 0.95; exhaustOpacity = 0.08;
    } else if (isolation === 'exhaust') {
      exhaustOpacity = 0.95; intakeOpacity = 0.08;
    } else if (isolation === 'power') {
      exhaustOpacity = 0.5; intakeOpacity = 0.08;
    } else {
      intakeOpacity = 0.44; exhaustOpacity = 0.08;
    }
    set('intake-flow', 'opacity', fixed(intakeOpacity));
    set('exhaust-flow', 'opacity', fixed(exhaustOpacity));
    set('intake-stream', 'stroke-dashoffset', fixed(-m.time * 34));
    set('exhaust-stream', 'stroke-dashoffset', fixed(-m.time * 34));

    // Ignition is at compression TDC (360°), shifted by the signed BTDC control.
    const ignitionAngle = mod(360 - sparkAdvance, 720);
    const angleDelta = mod(m.angle - ignitionAngle + 360, 720) - 360;
    const flash = clamp(1 - Math.abs(angleDelta) / 8);
    set('spark-flash', 'opacity', fixed(flash));
    set('spark-flash', 'transform', `translate(421 180) scale(${fixed(0.72 + flash * 0.42)})`);

    return { ...m, sparkFlash: flash };
  }
}

cases.title: 潮汐钟楼：海港蒸汽灯塔昼夜风暴视差剧场
cases.stability_reason: 两种指定桌面视口及全部关键帧均保持干净布局，遥测无重叠，未见裁切、断裂支点、画布变形或交互后残留。
cases.aesthetics_reason: 插画风格统一，铜金剖面、青白光束和深蓝海港具有良好视觉层次，控制栏与播放区完成度高；相较参考图，云层与船体细节略简化，部分辅助文字偏小，因此未达最高档。
cases.task_prompt:
我想做一个能放在海洋科普展网页里的「潮汐钟楼」互动剧场，整体构图请尽量贴近参考图：上方是一整条港口状态栏，有锚形标志、「TIDAL CLOCK / HARBOR No. 18」、绿色 HARBOR STATUS: ACTIVE、橙色 WEATHER: STORM 和蓝色 UTC 时间；下方左边约 84% 是海港画卷，右边约 16% 是深色仪表控制栏。主场景要有层次分明的暴风云、斜雨、稀疏星轨、紫蓝到橙粉的海天霞光和远海。中景左侧放一艘双桅帆船，桅杆、横桁、索具、至少三面主帆、船体和暖亮船舱都要看清；后方有石块防波堤和小导航标，海面有三层错峰推进的浪、白色泡沫和两座红色浮标。右前景是黑色层状悬崖、石砌蒸汽灯塔和相邻坡顶服务屋。灯塔请保留锥顶、灯室、环形菲涅尔透镜、回廊栏杆，以及从灯室射向左下海面的半透明体积光束。塔身正面做局部剖面，内部不能只是贴图，要能看到带齿形和轴心的大小啮合齿轮、擒纵机构、顶部支点钟摆、铜管、压力表、暖色壁灯、锅炉和楼梯，遮挡关系要合理。

请用 Canvas 2D 真正绘制这些部件，不要拿参考图或一张合成静图充当场景。整个 8 秒循环里，远景云和星轨缓慢漂移，雨丝连续下落，三层海浪以不同相位推进，帆船整体随波浪升沉并绕重心俯仰，两座浮标分别升沉摇摆，泡沫在浪尖流动；塔内齿轮按啮合方向反向转动，擒纵机构与钟摆协调，菲涅尔透镜和光束持续旋转扫描，海面反光与被照浮标同步响应。运动要由统一时间驱动，t=0 与 t=8 秒的画面和状态无缝一致，不能用各自独立的 CSS 或 SVG 动画时钟。

右栏请做四个我能直接操作的控件。“day night slider” 是 0–1 的昼夜滑块，拖动时天空、霞光、海面、星轨、船舱与服务屋窗灯、塔内灯和 UTC 时间连续联动，夜晚的光束更明显。“storm slider” 是 0–1 的风暴强度滑块，强度越高，云越密、雨越斜、浪和泡沫越强、船与浮标摆动越大，同时波形和风读数更新；调低时要明显平静，且船不能撞上防波堤或悬崖。“beam elevation” 是 0–90° 的光束仰角旋钮，默认 28°，光束必须绕灯室出光点转动，海面照明带、折射反光和浮标受光高光跟着移动。点击 “foghorn btn” 后，灯塔与服务屋附近出现 2–3 圈逐渐扩散并淡出的雾号压力环，信标和浮标短暂同步闪亮，波形读数出现对应脉冲后衰减；真实声音不是必须的。再放一个 “reset btn”，一键恢复默认深夜、风暴强度 0.78、仰角 28°、时间 0，并清除信标脉冲。右栏下方持续显示波形、风、灯功率和潮流读数，默认观感接近 4.8 m | 7.2 s、42 kts WNW、89% POWER、EBBING。

播放区提供 #play、#pause 和范围 0–8 秒的 #scrub，三者与画面时间双向同步。页面加载完成后设置 window.__SCENE_READY__ = true，提供确定性的 window.renderAt(t)，即使乱序跳帧也能只凭时间和当前控件参数得到正确画面；window.__getSceneState() 返回时间、播放状态、昼夜、风暴、仰角和信标脉冲等状态。所有舞台运动，包括按钮触发的脉冲，都要由这个场景时间计算，不能依赖未播种随机数或独立计时器。

交付 output/index.html、output/css/styles.css、至少 4 个职责清晰的 output/src/*.js ES modules，以及可离线播放的 output/preview.mp4 八秒预览；建议把场景绘制、机械与光学、天气海浪、交互时间轴分开。不得使用外部 CDN、远程字体或网络素材。以 1440×900 为设计基准，同时保证 1280×720 和 1440×900 两种桌面尺寸下舞台不变形、控件不裁切、标题与读数不互相覆盖，整体保持参考图那种深蓝石板色、铜金机械和青白光束的精致插画质感。各业务交互控件的具体布局样式与触发形式由你结合画面自行设计安排，确保直观易用。 在满足上述需求的前提下，请充分发挥创作能力，持续打磨整体美感、构图层次、材质光影与机械/动效细节精度，让作品具有极高的吸引力与完成度。

rubrics.criterion: 参考构图与多区层级的忠实度：顶部三枚状态胶囊、左侧前中远景画卷、右侧控制栏，以及帆船、防波堤、双浮标、悬崖灯塔和服务屋的位置比例。
rubrics.reason: 完整保留顶部三枚状态胶囊、左侧海港舞台与右侧窄控制栏；双桅帆船、防波堤、双浮标、三层海浪、悬崖灯塔和服务屋位置清楚，光束朝向左下，层级与遮挡稳定。

anchors.0: 缺少灯塔或帆船等主体，右侧控制栏与主画卷合并混乱，或用整张静态参考图代替场景，主要布局与参考明显不符。
anchors.0.5: 主要左右分区和主体均存在，但防波堤、服务屋、第二座浮标、顶部状态项等两处以上次要结构缺失，或灯塔与帆船比例、位置明显失衡。
anchors.1: 完整呈现顶部状态栏、左舞台和右控制栏；云雨霞光、防波堤双桅船、三层浪与双浮标、悬崖灯塔服务屋层次清楚，光束朝向左下，比例与遮挡贴近参考且无杂乱。

rubrics.criterion: 石砌灯塔局部剖面与蒸汽钟机的零件完整性、刚性支点和机械联动。
rubrics.reason: 石塔剖面内可见带齿形和轴心的大小齿轮、擒纵机构、顶部支点钟摆、铜管、压力表、壁灯、锅炉与楼梯；灯室、环形透镜和回廊栏杆完整，关键帧中的机械联动与支点关系合理。

anchors.0: 塔内没有可见机械，或齿轮钟摆只是合并静态图案；灯室、透镜、回廊和剖面中有多项主体缺失。
anchors.0.5: 塔身剖面与部分齿轮、钟摆可见，但齿形或轴心含糊，缺少擒纵协调、铜管压力表、锅炉楼梯中的两类以上，或出现齿轮分离、钟摆绕错误位置摆动。
anchors.1: 石塔、锥顶灯室、环形透镜、栏杆和完整剖面清楚；大小齿轮绕各自轴心反向啮合，擒纵与顶部支点钟摆协调，铜管、压力表、壁灯、锅炉和楼梯均有明确层次，运动无穿插。

rubrics.criterion: 8 秒内海浪、帆船、浮标、云雨星轨的多层视差与错峰运动，以及循环边界的视觉连续性。
rubrics.reason: 海浪、泡沫、船体升沉俯仰和双浮标响应具有错峰变化，云雨与星轨形成背景层次；帆船索具保持整体刚性，遥测显示循环边界像素差为 0，未见跳变或碰撞。

anchors.0: 海面与船基本静止，只有整幅画面平移或闪烁；船体与桅杆索具相互脱节，或 8 秒边界发生明显跳变。
anchors.0.5: 至少两层浪和船体有运动，但三层波相位趋同、浮标不随波、云雨缺少层次，或船体俯仰与升沉不协调并出现轻微穿浪。
anchors.1: 三层浪以不同速度和相位推进并带流动泡沫，帆船整体升沉俯仰且索具稳定，双浮标独立响应，云、星轨和斜雨形成远近视差，t=0 与 t=8 无缝衔接。

rubrics.criterion: 菲涅尔体积光、海面受光与折射反光的光学表现，以及深蓝、铜金、青白 palette 和文字排版完成度。
rubrics.reason: 青白柔边体积光从灯室连续发出，并配合海面照明、折射反光和浮标高光；深蓝石板、铜金机械与暖窗灯色彩统一，标题、胶囊、控件和读数排版完整。

anchors.0: 没有可辨体积光束，光束与灯室出光点断开，或文字控件严重裁切、低对比并遮挡主体。
anchors.0.5: 有锥形光束和基本灯室，但透镜环、海面照明带或浮标受光反馈不完整，光色与夜景曝光生硬，部分小字拥挤。
anchors.1: 透镜环、柔边青白体积光、海面照明带和折射反光层次统一，被照浮标有清楚高光；深蓝石板、铜金机械和暖窗灯对照明快，标题、胶囊、控件标签与读数精致且无裁切。

rubrics.criterion: 多文件 Canvas 2D 工程架构与离线交付完整性。
rubrics.reason: 交付包含 index、CSS、6 个职责清晰的本地 ES modules 和约 902 KB 的可播放预览，场景主体由 Canvas 2D 绘制，未显示外部网络依赖。

rubrics.criterion: window.renderAt(t) 的确定性、乱序求值能力、周期边界和统一场景状态接口。
rubrics.reason: 场景就绪与状态接口齐全；乱序 t=5 渲染及返回 t=0 均精确一致，t=0 与 t=8 差异为 0，说明机械、天气和瞬态均可由统一场景时间确定。

rubrics.criterion: #play、#pause、#scrub 与统一时间轴的双向耦合及重置行为。

rubrics.criterion: 1280×720 与 1440×900 两种桌面视口的响应式布局、清晰度和零重叠。

anchors.0: 任一指定视口出现舞台或控制栏大面积裁切、画布严重拉伸，或主要控件不可见不可点。
anchors.0.5: 两种尺寸均能操作，但存在局部文字重叠、读数溢出、灯塔或帆船变形、画布模糊等一种以上明显问题。
anchors.1: 两种视口均保持统一逻辑比例和完整左右层级，Canvas 按像素密度清晰绘制，顶部胶囊、场景标签、旋钮、按钮和全部读数无重叠、无裁切且点击区域充足。

anchors.1: 从白昼到深夜连续改变天空霞光、云雨和海面曝光，星轨与各暖灯按夜幕增强，光束对比同步提高，UTC 胶囊更新且所有机械和船体细节仍可辨。

rubrics.criterion: #storm-slider 对云雨、三层浪、船体、双浮标、泡沫和风浪读数的协调控制。
rubrics.reason: 风暴降至 0.15 后云雨、浪幅、泡沫和船体运动明显平静，天气转为 CALM，波形与风读数同步变为约 1.7 m、6.1 s 和 8 kts W，未见船体穿插。

anchors.0.5: 波幅和船体运动有变化，但云雨、泡沫、双浮标或读数中至少两项未联动，或高强度下三层浪合并、船与防波堤悬崖穿插。
anchors.1: 低强度明显平静，高强度云密雨斜、三层浪幅与泡沫增强且仍错峰，帆船升沉俯仰和双浮标响应同步加剧，波形与风读数连续更新，无碰撞穿插。

rubrics.criterion: #beam-elevation 与 #foghorn-btn 的光学、信标联动及 #reset-btn 清理。
rubrics.reason: 仰角调至 76.5° 后光束绕固定灯室出光点转动，海面受光区域随之移动；雾号交互可触发并由场景时间 scrub 重现扩散压力环、信标响应和波形脉冲，重置可清理全部瞬态。

anchors.0: 仰角旋钮或雾号按钮缺失、无响应，光束不绕灯室出光点转动，或点击后没有任何压力环与信标变化。

anchors.1: 0–90° 调节使出光点固定的光束、海面照明带、折射反光和浮标高光一致移动；雾号触发 2–3 圈扩散衰减压力环、信标与浮标同步闪亮及波形脉冲，重置恢复全部默认值并清除瞬态。

cases.title: Parametric Two-Stage Planetary Reducer Cutaway Demonstrator
cases.stability_reason: All eight parts are watertight, STEP and STL readbacks are consistent, and the views show clean edges and surfaces without degenerate slivers, floating shards, or clipping. The downward base explosion is a presentation-choice issue rather than a topology defect.
cases.aesthetics_reason: The assembly has harmonious silver, brass, and dark-steel coloring, plausible mechanical proportions, readable teeth and fasteners, and restrained edge detailing. It is slightly more visually dense and rectilinear around the pedestal and exposed stages than the polished reference, but remains a strong reconstruction.
cases.task_prompt:
Build a high-fidelity static CadQuery reconstruction of the supplied benchtop two-stage planetary reducer cutaway. Deliver a modular package under output/src/ with params.py defining DEFAULT_PARAMS in millimeters, individual part modules under output/src/parts/, and assembly.py exposing DEFAULT_PARAMS and build(params=None) -> cadquery.Assembly. Do not import file, network, or os modules inside output/src/*.py. Export the assembly as STEP, 3MF, STL, and GLB; run a pairwise B-rep collision check and report zero_interference=true only when every top-level pair has 0.0 mm^3 overlap; and render views_grid.png with four orthographic views, section_view.png on the Y=0 mid-plane, and exploded_view.png with the coaxial components separated along X.

Use Z up, X along the shaft from the handwheel toward the output, and Y across the base. Make YZ the primary drafting plane for the pedestal, barrel, cap, shafts, and gears, with orthogonal XY and XZ features for the base, T-slots, feet, and fasteners. Put the common axis at Y=0, Z=78 mm. Target a default overall envelope of 180 x 110 x 130 mm within +/-2 mm per axis, on a 180 x 110 x 10 mm baseplate.

Create exactly eight distinct, named, separately colored, non-interfering top-level parts: t_slot_baseplate, front_pedestal, rear_ring_barrel, input_handwheel, brass_input_sun_shaft, planet_carrier_module, output_bearing_cap, and hollow_output_shaft. Keep at least 60 B-rep faces in the complete assembly and make every exported solid watertight. Do not merge the assembly into one dead solid or replace its mechanical detail with flat silhouettes or textures.

Match the reference layout and proportions. The silver base has three X-parallel T-slots with real undercuts, mounting feet, and visible socket-head fasteners. The tall silver front pedestal has an input bearing boss and a large cutaway window exposing the first gear stage. At negative X, provide a silver three-spoke handwheel with a 76 mm outside diameter, circular rim, broad spokes, and central hub, followed by a stepped brass input shaft and toothed sun hub. The planet_carrier_module must visibly contain a brass carrier flange, three toothed planet gears at 120 degree spacing, three gear pins, and a second exposed gear stage; subsidiary elements may be separate solids inside this module, but the module cannot be a featureless disk. The silver rear barrel must include a cylindrical shell, an open cutaway sector, actual internal ring-gear teeth, and retaining lips. At positive X, use a stepped 104 mm diameter silver output flange with six socket-head bolts at 60 degree spacing, a central 32 mm bearing seat, and a stepped steel hollow output shaft. The shaft is 30 mm outside diameter with a default 12 mm coaxial through bore visibly open at its end and 1 mm nominal radial clearance in the cap seat. Add robust small chamfers or fillets to exposed housing, cap, handwheel, and shaft edges. Use silver or light gray housings and base, brass or gold input and carrier gearing, darker steel output, and contrasting dark metallic fasteners and pins. The section view must reveal the output through bore, cap seat, barrel ring teeth, retaining lips, and running clearances; the exploded view must preserve coaxial alignment and make all eight parts distinguishable.

DEFAULT_PARAMS must include housing_span_mm=65.0 and output_bore_mm=12.0. Support the probe --probe housing_span_mm=75: lengthen only the rear barrel by 10 mm along X and move the output cap and hollow output shaft 10 mm in positive X, while leaving the base, pedestal, handwheel, input member, gear diameters, axis height, cap bolt circle, and output bore unchanged. Support --probe output_bore_mm=16: resize the complete output through bore and visible end opening to 16 mm while keeping the 30 mm shaft OD, 32 mm cap seat, shaft steps, and all placements unchanged, leaving a 7 mm radial wall. Both probes must regenerate watertight parts with 0.0 mm^3 pairwise interference. Occluded details may be completed conservatively with coaxial shoulders, seats, lips, and webs; no animation, production gear rating, guards, labels, or unrelated mechanisms are required. Under the premise of satisfying the above requirements, please give full play to creativity and iteratively refine overall aesthetics, composition hierarchy, material/lighting craft, and mechanical/motion precision so the work is deeply attractive and complete.

rubrics.criterion: The complete silhouette and left-to-right arrangement faithfully match the reference: slotted base, tall windowed pedestal, handwheel and brass input, exposed first stage, cylindrical rear barrel with second stage, large output flange, and projecting hollow shaft.
rubrics.reason: The slotted base, tall windowed pedestal, handwheel, brass input, exposed gearing, cutaway barrel, large output flange, and projecting hollow shaft appear in the correct left-to-right order. Proportions are convincing and the measured envelope is exactly 180 x 110 x 130 mm.

anchors.0: The model is a single generic block or omits the handwheel, windowed pedestal, barrel, or output shaft, so the reference machine silhouette is absent.
anchors.0.5: The principal left-to-right layout is recognizable, but one major stage or housing is missing, the base or shaft proportions are substantially wrong, or the cutaways conceal nearly all gearing.
anchors.1: All major reference masses and both exposed gear stages appear in the correct order with convincing proportions, coaxial shafts, open cutaways, and the specified default envelope.

rubrics.criterion: Mechanical subassembly detail is explicit: three undercut T-slots and mounting fasteners, three-spoke handwheel, stepped brass sun shaft, three pinned planets and carrier, second-stage teeth, internal ring teeth, and six-bolt output cap.
rubrics.reason: The renders show three undercut T-slots, mounting fasteners, a three-spoke handwheel, stepped brass input and toothed hub, three pinned planets, a second toothed stage, internal barrel teeth, and six distinct output-cap bolts. These features are modeled geometry rather than surface markings.

anchors.0: Gears, spokes, slots, and bolts are absent, painted on, or represented only by featureless cylinders and disks.
anchors.0.5: Most primary details exist, but the planet count or pin spacing is wrong, the second stage is rudimentary, T-slot undercuts are absent, or the cap does not show six distinct bolts.
anchors.1: Every listed feature is modeled in geometry with the specified counts and spacing, readable tooth profiles, stepped shafts, real slot undercuts, and clear fastener and pin detail.

rubrics.criterion: The Y=0 section view exposes credible internal construction, including the hollow output bore, 30/32 mm shaft-to-cap clearance, barrel ring teeth, retaining lips, bearing seats, and stepped shaft shoulders.
rubrics.reason: The mid-plane section clearly exposes the hollow output bore, stepped shaft and cap seat, internal ring teeth, retaining lips, gear interiors, and separated running surfaces. The output end opening is also visible in the assembled views.

anchors.0: No useful section is supplied, or the section shows solid shafts and featureless housing interiors with none of the required bores or seats.
anchors.0.5: The output bore and some housing interior are visible, but retaining lips, ring teeth, bearing seats, or the stated radial clearance are incomplete or ambiguous.
anchors.1: A clean mid-plane section clearly reveals every listed internal feature, the open output bore, stepped shoulders, and visibly non-interfering running fits.

rubrics.criterion: The exploded view separates all eight top-level parts along X while preserving their common YZ orientation and coaxial shaft, gear, barrel, cap, and bore alignment.
rubrics.reason: The eight components are distinguishable and the principal coaxial group separates in a logical X-directed sequence with aligned bores. However, the baseplate is displaced substantially downward rather than separated along X, so the explosion does not strictly preserve a common X-only layout for every part.

anchors.0: The assembly remains unexploded, parts are randomly scattered, or multiple major components are fused so the eight-part structure cannot be inspected.
anchors.0.5: An exploded view exists and most components separate sensibly, but one or more named parts remain hidden, overlap, or lose coaxial alignment.
anchors.1: All eight named parts are visibly separated in a logical X-directed sequence with aligned bores and axes and no obscuring overlap.

rubrics.criterion: Part colors and four-view presentation clearly differentiate silver structure, brass input and carrier gearing, steel output, and dark fasteners while keeping the cutaway details legible.
rubrics.reason: Silver housings and base, brass gearing, darker steel output components, and dark fasteners are consistently differentiated. All four orthographic presentation panels are clean, and the cutaway and section views keep the major mechanical details legible.

anchors.0: Everything is one undifferentiated color or the views are missing, clipped, or too poorly oriented to identify the assembly.
anchors.0.5: Some material grouping and multiple views are present, but adjacent parts share confusing colors or important gearing and output details are obscured.
anchors.1: Distinct material colors consistently identify the eight parts and their subfeatures, and four clean orthographic views plus the cutaway presentation keep all major details legible.

rubrics.criterion: The source and exports preserve exactly eight named top-level parts, each composed of watertight B-rep solids, with at least 60 assembly faces and the required modular CadQuery build interface.
rubrics.reason: Inspection confirms the required modular source files, exactly eight named watertight top-level parts, successful STEP readback with 34 solids, and 1843 B-rep faces, well above the 60-face minimum.

anchors.0: The build fails, exports are absent or non-solid, or the machine is delivered as one merged part.
anchors.0.5: The build runs with at least four solid parts, but one or more of the eight named parts is missing, non-watertight, incorrectly exposed by the API, or the face count is below 60.
anchors.1: params.py, part modules, and assembly.py provide the required interface; STEP and 3MF contain all eight named watertight top-level parts and the assembly has at least 60 B-rep faces.

rubrics.criterion: The default assembly respects the 180 x 110 x 130 mm envelope within +/-2 mm per axis, the Y=0 and Z=78 mm shaft axis, and the specified handwheel, cap, shaft, bore, and base dimensions.
rubrics.reason: The default and STEP envelopes both measure exactly 180 x 110 x 130 mm. The rendered geometry shows the specified coaxial layout, base, handwheel, cap flange, stepped 30 mm output shaft, open default bore, and cap seat without evident dimensional discrepancies.

anchors.0: The axis or principal dimensions are missing or the envelope differs by more than 10 mm on any axis.
anchors.0.5: The overall envelope is within tolerance, but two or more secondary dimensions or the shaft-axis height are outside reasonable reconstruction tolerance.
anchors.1: The envelope, base, axis location, 76 mm handwheel, 104 mm cap flange, 30 mm shaft OD, 12 mm bore, and 32 mm cap seat all satisfy the stated dimensions.

rubrics.criterion: Every pair of top-level parts has exactly 0.0 mm^3 positive-volume B-rep interference in the default assembly, including fasteners, pins, gear teeth, shaft seats, and housing lips.
rubrics.reason: The exhaustive collision inspection covers all 28 top-level pairs, reports a maximum intersection volume of 0.0 mm^3, lists no interfering pairs, and sets zero_interference to true.

anchors.0: A primary shaft, housing, gear module, or base pair has substantial overlap, or no valid collision result is produced.
anchors.0.5: The main bodies clear one another, but localized fastener, tooth, pin, lip, or seat overlaps remain, or the report does not cover every pair.
anchors.1: An exhaustive pairwise check reports 0.0 mm^3 for all 28 top-level pairs and zero_interference=true without hiding or deleting mating geometry.

rubrics.criterion: Compound geometry is genuinely constructed: three T-slot undercuts, pedestal window and bearing boss, three planets and pins at 120 degrees, internal ring teeth and lips, second-stage teeth, six cap bolts at 60 degrees, stepped bores, and robust edge chamfers or fillets.
rubrics.reason: The exported B-rep and views demonstrate genuine slot undercuts, pedestal openings and boss, repeated planets and pins, ring and second-stage teeth, cap bolts, stepped bores, retaining lips, and small edge treatments with the required counts and spacing.

anchors.0: Most compound features are omitted or faked with textures, and the housings and gears remain primitive blocks or cylinders.
anchors.0.5: The main cuts and repeated features exist, but one compound group is incomplete, counts or angular spacing are wrong, or internal lips and edge treatments are largely absent.
anchors.1: All listed cuts, teeth, repeated features, seats, lips, steps, and edge treatments are present with correct counts and angular spacing and export as valid B-rep geometry.

rubrics.criterion: All required deliverables are reproducible from the modular source without file, network, or os imports inside output/src/*.py, and the section, exploded, and four-view images correspond to the exported default model.
rubrics.reason: STEP, GLB, 3MF, and watertight STL exports are present and readable, with consistent dimensions. The four-view, section, and exploded images correspond to the same eight-part default assembly, and the required modular Python layout is present.

anchors.0: Source execution fails, prohibited imports prevent inspection, or STEP, 3MF, STL, GLB, and the three required image deliverables are largely missing.
anchors.0.5: The model builds and most exports exist, but one export or view is missing, stale, inconsistent with the assembly, or the source structure only partially follows the required module layout.
anchors.1: A clean rebuild produces all four export formats, the collision report, four-view grid, Y=0 section, and X-directed exploded view from the same default parameters with the required source layout and import restrictions.

rubrics.criterion: The housing_span_mm override parametrically lengthens the rear barrel and repositions the complete output group without changing unrelated geometry or introducing collisions.
rubrics.reason: At housing_span_mm=75 the build remains watertight and interference-free, and only the X envelope increases by exactly 10 mm, from 180 to 190 mm. The reported geometry change is consistent with lengthening the barrel and translating the output group while preserving the other axes and unrelated features.

anchors.0: The probe is ignored, the build fails, or changing the value distorts or disconnects the barrel and output group.
anchors.0.5: The barrel length or output position changes, but not by the required 10 mm, unrelated dimensions drift, or a local interference or non-watertight result appears.
anchors.1: At housing_span_mm=75 the barrel alone gains 10 mm in X, cap and output shaft translate exactly +10 mm, all listed unrelated dimensions remain unchanged, and all solids are watertight with 0.0 mm^3 pairwise interference.

rubrics.criterion: The output_bore_mm override rebuilds only the coaxial output through bore while preserving shaft outside geometry, cap fit, placement, watertightness, and clearance.
rubrics.reason: At output_bore_mm=16 the build remains watertight and interference-free with no envelope or placement change. The volume decreases by 5279.107 mm^3, consistent with enlarging only the coaxial through bore while retaining the shaft exterior and cap fit.

anchors.0: The probe is ignored, the bore remains 12 mm, the shaft becomes solid or invalid, or the build fails.
anchors.0.5: A 16 mm opening appears, but it does not pass through the full shaft, the OD or placement changes, the wall is incorrect, or interference or watertightness checks fail.
anchors.1: At output_bore_mm=16 the full coaxial bore and exposed end opening measure 16 mm, the 30 mm OD leaves a 7 mm radial wall, the 32 mm cap seat and all placements remain unchanged, and all checks pass with zero interference.
